hint_strategies.name: socratic_questioning
hint_strategies.description: Ask guiding questions to lead student to answer.
templates: What do you think {variable_name} represents here?
Have you checked the type of {variable}?
What is the condition for this loop to terminate?

hint_strategies.name: conceptual_reminder
hint_strategies.description: Remind student of the underlying concept.

hint_strategies.name: code_scaffold
hint_strategies.description: Provide a skeleton or structure of the solution.
templates: You might need a helper function here.

hint_strategies.name: direct_correction
hint_strategies.description: Point out the specific mistake and explain the fix.
templates: You are missing a colon at line {line_num}.
The variable {var} is not defined. Did you mean {similar_var}?
Indentation error: block is not aligned.

motivational_quotes: Mistakes are proof that you are trying.
Every expert was once a beginner.
Debugging is like being the detective in a crime movie where you are also the murderer.
